correctness.rationale: The original BPL PGF agrees with the factored PGF. Its log gives v_k as claimed; for b≤q all v_k>0 and the log intensities are summable, while b>q forces negative even v_k eventually. Independently, if all thinning PGF quotients P(z)/P(1−c+cz) are PGFs, expansion at c=1 makes the coefficient at z^k (1−c)(v_k−v_{k+1})+O((1−c)^2), so every adjacent difference must be nonnegative. The even-index normalized difference A−UR^k−VT^k increases when b≤q, and later odd ones strictly exceed A−UR²≥0 if d₂≥0. Conversely, when all differences d_k≥0, their sum is v₁, with exponential tail. Integrating the logarithmic derivative along z↦1−exp(−s)+exp(−s)z represents the thinning quotient as the PGF for Poisson batch arrivals surviving independent unit-rate deaths over s in [0,−log c]. This verifies sufficiency and the stationary process interpretation. Independent rational reproduction at θ=1/10 gave the claimed pairs: (−4490/53361,388100/12326391), (137971/5336100,252509699/12326391000), (19226/53361,−479344/4108797). The b=0 point is explicitly an endpoint comparison, not a violation of the stated strict α range; by continuity failure also holds for small positive b. The frozen checker and verification were inspected, not run. Replay: frozen proof §§1–5 or the quotient and batch argument above; the finite grid alone does not decide infinitely many indices.
